|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #1a sheet (PDF made 5 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “Deploy - 1 and forfeit +3 at a site. Once per turn, you may peek at the top card of opponent's Used Pile or Reserve Deck; you may then reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 3.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Virtual Set #1 sheet hosted by Decipher (PDF made 6 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “Deploy - 1 and forfeit +3 at a site. Once per turn, you may peek at the top card of opponent's Used Pile or Reserve Deck; you may then reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 3.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same as the previous version; the slip's look differs (Decipher's sheet prints Dark Side text boxes black on white and prints collector numbers V1•1–V1•12; the 5 March sheet prints Dark Side boxes white on black and no numbers). Listed as its own version because it is a separate publication (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 1: Legacy, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy -1 and forfeit +3 at a site. Once per turn, may peek at top card of opponent’s Reserve Deck or Used Pile; may then shuffle that Reserve Deck or Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 3.” '''What changed:''' “- 1” → “-1”; removed “you”; removed “the”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s Reserve Deck or”; “Pile or Reserve Deck; you” → “Pile;”; “reshuffle.” → “shuffle that Reserve Deck or Used Pile.”.
